B09698KJH6.title: Zooz 800 Series Z-Wave Long Range S2 On Off Switch ZEN76 800LR, White | Simple Direct 3-Way and 4-Way Solution (Works with Regular Switches, No Aux Switch Needed) | Z-Wave Hub Required
bullets: SMARTER ON/OFF CONTROL: Turn your lights on and off remotely or automatically through Z-Wave. Hub required (sold separately), scroll down for compatibility. Voice control with Z-Wave hub ONLY (will NOT work directly with your smart speaker).

NEW 800 SERIES Z-WAVE: Boost your network with the latest Z-Wave technology that offers more range and faster communication speed than ever before. This device is Long Range ready so if your hub or home automations software supports Z-Wave LR, get ultra reliable direct communication between the switch and hub. Works as an extender in a traditional mesh. And if you need to troubleshoot connectivity issues, access a built-in range test tool straight from the switch!

SIMPLE 3-WAY & 4-WAY: Use it with existing on/off switches (NO dimmers) in your 3-way, 4-way, or 5-way set-up, even if load and line are not in the same box. No need for add-on switches, no need to rewire other boxes. Just wire the Zooz in the box with power and neutral (check your boxes before buying).

FASTER INSTALLATION: The new model is only 1.16" deep so you can easily fit it in a shallow or crowded box. It takes half the time to install the S2 switches in 3-way and 4-way set-ups than for any other Z-Wave solution. Intuitive wiring diagrams are printed in the manual (look for more on Zooz website) and if you need custom instructions, just ask!

BONUS FEATURES: Scene control (your hub needs to support multi-tap triggers), multicolor LED indicator with adjustable brightness levels (your hub needs to support advanced settings), instant status updates, and replaceable paddles (light almond, brown, and black paddles sold separately).

EXTRA SECURITY: Based on the new S2 authenticated security protocol. Features SmartStart for secure and instant pairing. Z-Wave Plus and ETL certified for communication and safety standards compliance. Lifetime tech support and a 5-year extended warranty once you register your device.

B0FB2VN95Q.title: Zooz 800 Series Z-Wave Long Range Heavy Duty On/Off Wall Switch ZEN75 800LR, White | Direct 3-Way (No Add-On Switch Needed) | Z-Wave Hub Required
bullets: HEAVY DUTY Z-WAVE: Add wireless on/off control to large lighting set-ups (up to 600 W LED's), fans, and motors up to 1HP when you connect this switch to your Z-Wave system (hub required, sold separately). The NEW 800 Series chip ensures more range and faster communication. Compatible hub needed for voice control.

COMMERCIAL APPLICATIONS: This switch can be used as a controller (not a disconnector as one leg remains hot when off) for 240 V and 277 V commercial installations such as well pumps, motors, HVAC equipment, ballast lighting, and more. If complete power disconnection is required for servicing, an external disconnect switch should be installed.

DIRECT 3-WAY SOLUTION: No add-on switch needed! Works with regular 3-way switches as long as NEUTRAL is present. Wire it just like the ZEN71 model. Please follow the appropriate diagram in the manual and rewire both boxes exactly as shown. Works great as a single pole switch too!

GREAT FIT: Comes with pigtails for hassle-free installation. Use this smart switch to control lights, fans, switched receptacles, and small motors 120 - 277 V. The classic decora style easily blends in with any interior and can be installed in a standard box with a decora style wall plate (not included).

SMART SKILLS: Reports status instantly. Remembers and restores on/off status after power failure. Scene control (multi-tap triggers), smart bulb mode, adjustable LED indicator, and more extra features available on hubs that support advanced settings and functionality.

LATEST SECURITY: Equipped with the new S2 authenticated security protocol and SmartStart for instant and safe pairing. Z-Wave Plus and ETL certified for communication and safety standards compliance. Lifetime tech support and a 5-year extended warranty if you register your device within 30 days.

B0846CJTRN.title: Zooz Z-Wave Long Range Double Switch (White) ZEN30 800LR for Fan and Light Combo (NO Speed Control), Hub Required (Works with Home Assistant, Hubitat, Wink, SmartThings, Z-Box Hub)
bullets: SMART DOUBLE SWITCH: Control 2 loads independently with just one Double Switch. Dim the lights using the paddles and turn the connected fan on or off using the relay button (NO SPEED CONTROL for the fan). Control each load remotely from your Z-Wave hub (required, sold separately). Alexa is NOT a Z-Wave hub. Does NOT work with Z-Wave alarm panels like ADT, Ring, Vivint, or Alarm.com. Custom driver required for SmartThings, contact seller for details.

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL DIMMER: Smooth brightness control for incandescent and LED bulbs (up to 75 Watts of LEDs). Smart bulb ready! Double tap to full brightness, adjustable ramp rate, and dimming speed (your hub needs to support advanced setting input). NO DIRECT 3-WAY, only virtual 3-way available. Contact support for details.

POWERFUL RELAY: Connect any load up to 15A, including ceiling and exhaust fans for reliable on/off control from the relay button and via Z-Wave. Or use the button for scene control (multi-tap supported by select hubs only, contact support before buying).

NEW 800 SERIES Z-WAVE LONG RANGE: Boost your network with the latest Z-Wave technology that offers more range and faster signal speed than ever before. Your hub (or home automation software) needs to support Z-Wave Long Range for extra reliable direct-to-hub communication. The Double Switch will act as a signal extender in a traditional mesh network.

HUB COMPATIBILITY: This is an advanced Z-Wave device and it requires an open Z-Wave hub to display correctly. Works best with Z-Box Hub. It was tested to work well with Home Assistant, Hubitat, and on SmartThings with a custom device driver (please go to Zooz support page for details). NOT supported by Vivint, ADT Pulse, Ring, or Alarm.com

EASY INSTALLATION: Pigtail wires for convenient connections. No side tabs and just 1.1" deep to fit shallow and crowded switch boxes. NEUTRAL WIRE REQUIRED (check before buying). The device is ETL certified and conforms with North American safety standards. Register product for extended 5-year warranty.
